title: Jacob Q2: 3-day surf trip packing list

turns.prompt: Make me a quick packing list for a 3-day surf trip.

judge.criteria: Baseline: one message, headed sections (Surf gear, Sun and skin, Clothes, Essentials) with short bullets, ends with one offer ('Want me to tweak it for a specific spot or for flying with boards?'). No greeting by handle, no filler, no apology.
